Tallyfern
Bookkeeping on autopilot for independent restaurants
Seed round · 2026

[Slide 2]
Problem
Independent restaurants spend 6+ hours a week reconciling invoices and delivery-app payouts
62% of owners we surveyed do their books after closing time

[Slide 3]
Solution
Tallyfern connects the POS, bank and delivery apps and closes the books every night
Owners approve exceptions from their phone in under 5 minutes

[Slide 4]
Market
33,000 independent restaurants in Texas alone; $4.1B US small-business bookkeeping spend

[Slide 5]
Business Model
SaaS: $149 per location per month

[Slide 6]
Traction
41 paying restaurants across Austin and Houston
$73K ARR, growing 14% month over month
Net revenue retention 118%
Pilot with a 12-location regional chain signed in August 2026
